criteria.requirement: A rectangular 3D boot has editable dimensions with centimeter measurements and several differently sized bags.
criteria.action: Inspect the initial bags and edit the boot dimensions.
criteria.expected: Several differently sized bags occupy a rectangular 3D boot with editable centimeter measurements.

criteria.requirement: Bags can be moved and turned, and their visible geometry follows the edits.
criteria.action: Move and rotate differently sized bags.
criteria.expected: Visible bag geometry follows the selected positions and rotations.

criteria.requirement: Geometric overlaps and outside bags are flagged, including rotated cases; total volume alone is not treated as proof of fit.
criteria.action: Create overlapping bags and protruding bags, including a rotated case.
criteria.expected: Geometric overlap and outside warnings follow actual placements rather than total volume alone.

criteria.requirement: The displayed number of fitting bags updates coherently as bags or boot dimensions change.
criteria.action: Move a bag outside and back, then resize the boot.
criteria.expected: The number of fitting bags updates consistently with the displayed fit conditions.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect dimensions and the initial bag arrangement/count.
Move and rotate one bag and change a boot dimension while comparing visual fit and counts.
Create an overlap and outside case, then recover a valid layout and inspect measurements on mobile.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
